info.name: Rodha Website Student Registration & Books
info.description:
Website Student Masters, one-time post-purchase Registration Form (with soft-block deadline), package books, Repeater promocodes, and Book Dispatch (Admin + Book Store Manager).

Use environment **Rodha Local** (`{{baseUrl}}` = `http://localhost:5000/rodha/`).

**Run order:** 00 Auth (admin / book store manager / student) → 01 deadline setting → 02 masters → 03 package books + repeater → purchase a package as the student (existing purchase collection) → 04 registration → 05 admin student detail → 06 book dispatches.

**Permissions:** masters `read/write_website_student_masters`; dispatches `read/write_book_dispatches`; packages `read/write_website_packages`; promocodes `read/write_website_promocodes`; student detail `read/write_students`; deadline `read/write_system_settings`. Admin bypasses; Book Store Manager is a SUBADMIN user with the `book_store_manager` role (masked name/address/books-only responses).

**Soft block:** after the deadline (from first paid enrollment), student APIs return `403 { code: "REGISTRATION_REQUIRED", deadlineAt }` except logout, `/auth/me`, registration and profile.

exec: if (json.data?.roles?.length) { const r = json.data.roles.find(x => x.name === 'admin') || json.data.roles[0]; pm.collectionVariables.set('roleId', String(r.id)); }
